sphere_commentary.overview:
The three series show comparable average effectiveness, with HEALING demonstrating the greatest consistency and TRANSFORMING the greatest variability.
• HEALING leads in consistency (lowest variance) across its 12 protocols, indicating robust nervous system regulation.
• THRIVING matches HEALING in mean scores (~6.96) but with slightly higher variance in cognitive protocols.
• TRANSFORMING shows the lowest mean (6.59) and highest spread, consistent with its ascending-arc design for low-affect states.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
The series exhibit distinct statistical profiles aligned with their intended functions: HEALING for consistency, THRIVING for peak efficacy, TRANSFORMING for variability and upward potential.
• HEALING shows the lowest variance and consistent performance across protocols, supporting its regulation goal.
• THRIVING achieves the highest mean scores (e.g., T-FC-L3 at 7.63) but with notable internal spread in HOLD protocols.
• TRANSFORMING displays the greatest spread and lowest average mean, yet contains high-performing outliers like X-MD-L3.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
Several protocols exhibit statistical or qualitative patterns that deviate from series expectations, warranting targeted investigation.
• T-FC-L3 shows a right-skewed distribution with high scores at 10, suggesting a responder subgroup.
• X-MD-L3 (n=13, mean=7.15, std=2.38) exhibits high variance and outperforms its Motivation & Drive peers.
• X-MC-L3 has the lowest mean (5.70) in the library, indicating possible mismatch for the Mind & Clarity zone.
• T-FC-L1's modest mean contrasts with strong qualitative approval, suggesting the HOLD arc's subtle effect may be underestimated.
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Several protocols show actionable patterns for refinement based on outcome, qualitative, and variance signals.
• X-MC-L3: Consider a Level 2 variant or population split due to low mean and high variance (n=10).
• T-FC-L1: Explore a simpler rhythmic architecture (L2 variant) to reduce potential over-activation in focus protocol.
• X-MD-L1 and X-MD-L2: Test a steeper ease-in phase to improve entrainment for motivation protocols.
• T-MB-L3: Investigate Level 3 groove for rhythmic instability affecting settling in maintenance protocol.
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Extensive cross-run drift suggests evolving analytical understanding, while intra-zone clustering indicates consistent framework application.
• CROSS-RUN DRIFT: Most protocols show similarity <0.85, indicating substantial analytical shift as data accumulates.
• CROSS-PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: T-FC-L3, H-OS-L3, and T-CF-L3 are the most analytically distinct; L1-L2 pairs within zones cluster tightly.
• Confidence: Drift patterns are numerous but intra-zone consistency supports analytical stability despite evolving interpretations.
